Job Description: **About Us**

Tian Bao Travel is a travel services company dedicated to delivering high\-quality travel experiences for our clients. As our business continues to grow, we're looking for a thoughtful, execution\-driven Brand Strategy Manager to lead our team in telling Tian Bao's brand story — so that more travelers choose us because they trust us. If you understand both travel and branding, and love turning strategy into real, measurable growth, we'd love to hear from you.

**What You'll Do**

As Brand Strategy Manager, you'll own Tian Bao Travel's brand positioning and communications, including:

* Develop and execute the company's overall brand strategy — defining our positioning, core values, and points of differentiation so that "Tian Bao Travel" stands for something clear in customers' minds.
* Plan the annual brand communications calendar, designing brand campaigns around our product lines and peak travel seasons, and coordinating resources across online and offline channels.
* Lead our brand's visual identity and content tone, ensuring consistency across the website, social media accounts, short\-form video, and marketing collateral.
* Partner closely with the marketing, sales, and product teams to translate brand strategy into measurable customer acquisition and word\-of\-mouth growth.
* Manage external partners (advertising, design, PR, media, and KOLs/influencers), overseeing budget, timelines, and quality of output.
* Track industry trends and competitor moves, and continuously optimize our brand approach through data\-driven review.
* Lead the brand team — setting goals, assigning work, and coaching team members.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree or above; a major in Marketing, Communications, Advertising, Journalism, or a related field is preferred.
* 3\+ years of experience in brand strategy or brand marketing, including hands\-on ownership of brand projects; a background in travel, lifestyle, or consumer services is a plus.
* Strong end\-to\-end brand strategy thinking — able to connect positioning, content, and communications into a complete loop and drive it to execution.
* Excellent copywriting and communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey brand messaging; a good eye for visual design.
* Familiarity with the brand\-building logic of major platforms (e.g. WeChat, Douyin/TikTok, Xiaohongshu/RED); comfortable with both content and data.
* Solid project management and cross\-functional collaboration skills, able to run multiple projects at once.
* Team management or mentoring experience preferred.
* Genuine enthusiasm for the travel industry and a passion for helping people travel happily and worry\-free.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: $40,000\.00\-$60,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Life insurance

Company Name: Sunnybrook Health Sciences Centre

Source: indeed
Job Description: One of Canada's Top 10 Research Hospitals, Sunnybrook Research Institute is developing innovations in care for the more than 1\.3 million patients the hospital cares for annually.

  


Sunnybrook Research Institute is the research enterprise of Sunnybrook Health Sciences Centre, a teaching hospital fully affiliated with the University of Toronto. Research spans three Toronto\-based campuses, eight programs and three scientific platforms. Our main aims are to understand and prevent disease, and to develop treatments that enhance and extend life. Our vision is to invent the future of health care. Each year, we conduct about $100 million in research across 500,000 square feet, including in the world’s first Centre for Research in Image\-Guided Therapeutics.

  


Dr. Kozak’s research group is involved in studying emerging viruses to better understand viral pathogenesis, develop novel diagnostics and evaluate countermeasures. Additionally, work focuses on the genomic epidemiology of respiratory pathogens to better understand transmission and improve surveillance.

  


**Summary of Duties:**


The individual will assist with multiple ongoing research projects in the lab related to virology. These will include both wet\-lab based projects (eg. cell culture, animal studies) in both a BSL2 and potentially a BSL3 environment as well as patient reviews and analysis of patient samples. The individual will assist with reagent ordering and other lab operational duties as needed. Additionally, due to the nature of clinical trial work there may requirements for flexibility in availability (although this is infrequent and lab work is normally done Monday\-Friday 9 to 5\).

  


* Successful completion of a Bachelor of Science in a relevant field is required. A CRC is considered an asset
* A minimum of 1 year of experience in clinical laboratory
* A minimum of 2 years of experience in a research laboratory
* Experience writing manuscripts and conference abstracts
* Experience with molecular assays, specimen handling and processing clinical samples is required.
* Willingness to be trained to perform animal work, and experience working with animals is considered an asset
* Strong interpersonal, time management and organizational skills.
* Strong oral and written communication skills and attention to detail.
* Demonstrated proficiency in scientific writing
* Demonstrated knowledge of research regulations and guidelines (eg. clinical lab protocols, biosafety, etc)
* Demonstrate ability to train new members of a lab team in protocols
* Experience writing REB and CTO applications

  




**Qualifications:**


Bachelor of Science required (CRC an asset)

Tian Bao Travel is a travel services company dedicated to delivering high\-quality travel experiences for our clients. As our business continues to grow, we're looking for a thoughtful, execution\-driven Brand Strategy Manager to lead our team in telling Tian Bao's brand story — so that more travelers choose us because they trust us. If you understand both travel and branding, and love turning strategy into real, measurable growth, we'd love to hear from you.

**What You'll Do**

As Brand Strategy Manager, you'll own Tian Bao Travel's brand positioning and communications, including:

* Develop and execute the company's overall brand strategy — defining our positioning, core values, and points of differentiation so that "Tian Bao Travel" stands for something clear in customers' minds.
* Plan the annual brand communications calendar, designing brand campaigns around our product lines and peak travel seasons, and coordinating resources across online and offline channels.
* Lead our brand's visual identity and content tone, ensuring consistency across the website, social media accounts, short\-form video, and marketing collateral.
* Partner closely with the marketing, sales, and product teams to translate brand strategy into measurable customer acquisition and word\-of\-mouth growth.
* Manage external partners (advertising, design, PR, media, and KOLs/influencers), overseeing budget, timelines, and quality of output.
* Track industry trends and competitor moves, and continuously optimize our brand approach through data\-driven review.
* Lead the brand team — setting goals, assigning work, and coaching team members.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree or above; a major in Marketing, Communications, Advertising, Journalism, or a related field is preferred.
* 3\+ years of experience in brand strategy or brand marketing, including hands\-on ownership of brand projects; a background in travel, lifestyle, or consumer services is a plus.
* Strong end\-to\-end brand strategy thinking — able to connect positioning, content, and communications into a complete loop and drive it to execution.
* Excellent copywriting and communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey brand messaging; a good eye for visual design.
* Familiarity with the brand\-building logic of major platforms (e.g. WeChat, Douyin/TikTok, Xiaohongshu/RED); comfortable with both content and data.
* Solid project management and cross\-functional collaboration skills, able to run multiple projects at once.
* Team management or mentoring experience preferred.
* Genuine enthusiasm for the travel industry and a passion for helping people travel happily and worry\-free.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: $40,000\.00\-$60,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Life insurance

Job Description: One of Canada's Top 10 Research Hospitals, Sunnybrook Research Institute is developing innovations in care for the more than 1\.3 million patients the hospital cares for annually.

  


Sunnybrook Research Institute is the research enterprise of Sunnybrook Health Sciences Centre, a teaching hospital fully affiliated with the University of Toronto. Research spans three Toronto\-based campuses, eight programs and three scientific platforms. Our main aims are to understand and prevent disease, and to develop treatments that enhance and extend life. Our vision is to invent the future of health care. Each year, we conduct about $100 million in research across 500,000 square feet, including in the world’s first Centre for Research in Image\-Guided Therapeutics.

  


Dr. Kozak’s research group is involved in studying emerging viruses to better understand viral pathogenesis, develop novel diagnostics and evaluate countermeasures. Additionally, work focuses on the genomic epidemiology of respiratory pathogens to better understand transmission and improve surveillance.

  


**Summary of Duties:**


The individual will assist with multiple ongoing research projects in the lab related to virology. These will include both wet\-lab based projects (eg. cell culture, animal studies) in both a BSL2 and potentially a BSL3 environment as well as patient reviews and analysis of patient samples. The individual will assist with reagent ordering and other lab operational duties as needed. Additionally, due to the nature of clinical trial work there may requirements for flexibility in availability (although this is infrequent and lab work is normally done Monday\-Friday 9 to 5\).

  


* Successful completion of a Bachelor of Science in a relevant field is required. A CRC is considered an asset
* A minimum of 1 year of experience in clinical laboratory
* A minimum of 2 years of experience in a research laboratory
* Experience writing manuscripts and conference abstracts
* Experience with molecular assays, specimen handling and processing clinical samples is required.
* Willingness to be trained to perform animal work, and experience working with animals is considered an asset
* Strong interpersonal, time management and organizational skills.
* Strong oral and written communication skills and attention to detail.
* Demonstrated proficiency in scientific writing
* Demonstrated knowledge of research regulations and guidelines (eg. clinical lab protocols, biosafety, etc)
* Demonstrate ability to train new members of a lab team in protocols
* Experience writing REB and CTO applications

  




**Qualifications:**


Bachelor of Science required (CRC an asset)
